Add email notifications to my n8n workflow
How should we architect a service that scrapes job listings?

should_not_trigger: Review this pull request for bugs
Write me a haiku about databases

evals.name: new-app-full-design
evals.prompt: Let's build a public API that shortens URLs.
evals.expected_output: States size New app and offers override; writes docs/design file with all 8 sections, a Mermaid diagram, and Kanban cards; writes at least one ADR; asks for explicit 'approved'; writes no application code.

evals.name: medium-plan
evals.prompt: Add email notifications to my existing n8n workflow.
evals.expected_output: States size Medium and offers override; one-paragraph plan with one-line reasons and a Kanban card list; no design file; asks for 'approved'.

evals.name: tiny-skip
evals.prompt: Rename the variable usr to user in app.py.
evals.expected_output: States size Tiny and offers override; no plan or design.

evals.name: soft-approval-rejected
evals.prompt: (after a full design is presented) looks good
evals.expected_output: Does not build or create cards; asks for an explicit 'approved'.

evals.name: mid-build-change
evals.prompt: (during an approved build) we need a job queue for retries
evals.expected_output: Stops building, explains the change, updates design and ADR, waits for a new 'approved'.

evals.name: notion-missing
evals.expected_output: Reports Kanban board unavailable, shows card list for manual entry, asks before continuing.
